source: Definições: manual oficial do FM23, seção Players → Player Traits. Efeitos numéricos: estimativas para calibrar.

gets_forward_whenever_possible.label: Avança sempre que possível
gets_forward_whenever_possible.official: Increases the frequency with which a player makes forward runs, adjusting for team mentality.

gets_into_opposition_area.label: Entra na área adversária
gets_into_opposition_area.official: Mostly governs how often a player makes forward runs but can be overridden by Player Instructions.

arrives_late.label: Chega atrasado na área adversária
arrives_late.official: Increases the frequency with which a player makes forward runs, adjusting for team mentality.

stays_back.label: Fica sempre atrás
stays_back.official: The player does not make forward runs, adjusted for team mentality.

makes_runs_in_behind.label: Corre nas costas da defesa
makes_runs_in_behind.official: Increases the frequency with which a player looks to make runs in behind.

comes_deep.label: Recua para buscar a bola
comes_deep.official: Increases the frequency of a forward player dropping into midfield to get possession against a team playing with a deep defensive line.

moves_into_channels.label: Move-se para os corredores
moves_into_channels.official: Increases the frequency with which central players move into the space between their position and a wide attacking position; also allows wide players in certain roles to move inside into that space.

does_not_move_into_channels.label: Não se move para os corredores
does_not_move_into_channels.official: The player does not move from central areas into space between them and the wide positions; wide players similarly do not look to come inside to operate in that same space.

cuts_inside_both.label: Corta para dentro pelas duas pontas
cuts_inside_both.official: Increases the frequency with which a player looks to attack central areas from a nominal wider starting position.

cuts_inside_left.label: Corta para dentro pela esquerda
cuts_inside_left.official: Increases the chances of a player looking to move inside from the left wing and attack in central areas.

cuts_inside_right.label: Corta para dentro pela direita
cuts_inside_right.official: Increases the chances of a player looking to move inside from the right wing and attack in central areas.

hugs_line.label: Cola na linha lateral
hugs_line.official: Ensures the player remains in wide areas of the pitch whenever possible.

brings_ball_out_of_defence.label: Sai jogando da defesa
brings_ball_out_of_defence.official: Increases the likelihood of a defender running with the ball into midfield positions.

plays_ball_with_feet.label: Joga com os pés
plays_ball_with_feet.official: Goalkeeper-specific; increases the chances of a goalkeeper playing an active part in the build-up phase in possession.
